title: Icon and text action group
description: Compose visual actions and list item triggers using Icon, Button, and Box. The Icon provides semantic visual cues while preserving accessible text labels.
useWhen: Creating toolbar actions, kitchen ticketing controls, order modifiers, or navigation items with icon embellishments.
rules: Use Icon name to specify standard iconography (e.g., 'cart', 'chef', 'pizza', 'check', 'arrow-right').
Use Box flex direction='row' align='center' to align Icons with text labels.
Pair visual icons with explicit text labels or provide aria-label when rendering standalone icon buttons for screen readers.
Choose Button size ('s' | 'm' | 'l') and variant ('primary' | 'secondary' | 'attention' | 'link') based on visual hierarchy.
